blocks.text: Aaloodgi neeche diye tareeqon se qaboo ki ja sakti hai:

items: Sanaton aur baladiyat par ikhraj ke sakht mayaar laagu karna, taake nuqsan-deh aaloodgi aabi zakhiron mein na jaye.
Sewage treatment plants (STPs) ko behtar aur wasee karna, effluent treatment plants (ETPs) lagana, aur membrane filtration aur bioreactors jaisi jadeed technology apnana.
Pani ke mayaar ki musalsal nigrani, jo aaloodgi pakarti aur aaloodgi ke waqiat par bar-waqt radd-e-amal mumkin banati hai.
Aaloodgi phailane walon par sakht jurmane aur saaf tareeqon par targheebat, jo khilaf-warzi ki hosla-shikni karte aur sanaton aur muashron ko pa-idar, aaloodgi se pak kaam apnane par ubharte hain.

blocks.prompt: Do tareeqe batayein jin se hukoomatein pani ki aaloodgi qaboo kar sakti hain.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: ikhraj ke sakht mayaar; zyada aur behtar sewage aur effluent treatment plants; pani ke mayaar ki musalsal nigrani; aaloodgi walon par jurmane aur saaf tareeqon par targheebat.

items: Ikhraj ke mayaar; STPs aur ETPs; nigrani; jurmane aur targheebat.
